title.zh: 所得税（合资格个人在第 14ZD 条下的支出扣除）规则 2019
title.en: Income Tax (Deduction for Expenditure of Qualifying Individual under Section 14ZD) Rules 2019

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Rules are the Income Tax (Deduction for Expenditure of Qualifying Individual under Section 14ZD) Rules 2019 and come into operation on 2 December 2019.

3. For the purposes of section 14ZD of the Act, “commission” includes any allowance, incentive, referral fee or other payment that is chargeable to tax under section 10(1)(a) of the Act, and that is derived by an individual from carrying on a prescribed activity.
